body: Addressed in follow-up PR #1223. Added focused Jest coverage for missing/malformed projection inputs that asserts validator failure and diagnostics, plus malformed-row copy-preparation coverage that asserts skip counts and diagnostics.

Addressed in follow-up PR #1223. The artifact builder now uses safe JSON loading with file-existence and malformed-JSON diagnostics, carries input_diagnostics into the receipt, and makes the validator fail closed through source_artifact_presence and input_diagnostics_absent checks.

Addressed in follow-up PR #1223. Copy preparation now validates row shape before property access, skips malformed rows, records malformed_projection_row_skipped diagnostics, and uses safe fallbacks for optional payload fields.
